thesis: The episode explores the behaviors and routines of extraordinary leaders through conversations with Randall Stutman, a coach who has advised hundreds of CEOs and senior executives at major firms. The discussion covers Stutman's transition from academia to executive coaching, his development of the 'Admired Leadership' course based on 100 behaviors observed in top CEOs, and the application of these insights to capital allocation and manager research.
